status: Locally frozen CPU model study; exploratory, single-model, and not a provider-comparison or reasoning-budget study
implementation_amendment: Runtime checksums and interruption logging were added after the smoke test; factorial cells, seeds, prompts, outcomes, and analysis were unchanged. The full run began before those error-path changes, so an abrupt interruption could leave its in-flight attempt unrecorded; only flushed episode rows enter the analysis.

model.inference: llama.cpp server b12030 CPU x64, deterministic decoding (temperature 0)

environment.design: Complete 2^5 factorial, generated from the same eight paired seeds; same work and state alphabet throughout.
environment.failure_protocol: Invalid JSON, invalid action, candidate error, or dependency error terminates that episode; no retries. Runtime/request interruptions are stored separately in attempts.jsonl and are excluded from primary analyses.

prompting.interface: Text prompt with complete task specification, current observation, and action/feedback history; one next action per response.

analysis.primary: Paired high-minus-low success-rate differences for topology, depth, branching, register width, and feedback, averaged over other factorial conditions.
analysis.uncertainty: Seed-cluster bootstrap intervals; tasks sharing a seed are kept together.
analysis.secondary: Failure categories and per-factor-level success; factorial interactions are descriptive because eight seed clusters do not power stable high-order interaction claims.
analysis.exclusions: Only complete, unique preregistered seed-by-factorial-cell episodes enter the primary analysis. Interrupted episodes are retained separately and are not silently replaced.
analysis.multiplicity: No confirmatory significance claims; all effect estimates are descriptive with uncertainty intervals.

resource_limitations: No paid API calls or external provider inference.
One 0.5B-parameter quantized model only; results cannot support frontier-model or cross-provider claims.
CPU runtime may limit completion; any incomplete cells will be reported.
